Speak to our expert team today: 07966555586 Out of stock Description Additional information Biyang Tonefancier BL-8 Blue Overdrive In great condition · Blues overdrive. · Level & Drive controls. · True bypass. · Durable metal casing. · Takes a 9v battery / adaptor. A smooth, rich and creamy Blues overdrive pedal from the Biyang Tonefancier range. Influenced by the Boss Blues Driver BD2, it actually tries to improve upon the classic formula. Some reviewers actually prefer it! As the name suggests this pedal is best suited to blues, but also is great for R&B, Jazz, Country and Funk. However it’s a versatile pedal and can produce a wide range of sounds depending on how you manipulate the Level and Drive controls. It can sound pretty heavy when the Gain is turned all the way up. But even at lower levels it sounds full with a decent amount of sustain. The BL8 has a durable polished metal casing with no slip rubber feet. It’s true bypass so doesn’t impact your tone when off. While the pedal does work with a 9v battery (accessed by a compartment in the back), it’s best to use an adaptor as batteries don’t last very long.
